MARKETING / 5 MIN READ

Make your business easier to find locally

A grounded introduction to local search visibility for service businesses.

EasyOra Editorial · Practical guide

Make your business information consistent

Use accurate business details wherever you publish them. Your website should clearly explain what you offer, the areas you serve, and how people can contact you. Keep opening hours and public contact information up to date.

Build useful service pages

Explain services in the words your customers use. Include practical details, common questions, and relevant local context. Avoid creating many nearly identical location pages with little value for the visitor.

Look after your business profile

If your business is eligible for a business listing, provide accurate categories, service information, and authentic imagery. Check the platform’s current eligibility rules before creating or changing a listing.

Earn trust through real experiences

Ask customers for honest feedback without scripting their opinion. Publish testimonials only with permission, and respond thoughtfully to questions. Never invent reviews or present concept projects as client work.

Review progress with context

Search visibility changes with competition, location, content, and many other factors. Review relevant queries, website visits, and qualified enquiries together. Treat SEO as ongoing improvement, without promising a particular rank or number of leads.
